recommendedMinimum: Reuse any existing engine and matching installation first; no installer unless the user explicitly selects preparation and no matching ready engine exists.

For the current Docker bundle, present one Docker Desktop official preparation action with clear conditional license eligibility and official terms. If paid eligibility is required, stop without charge or automatic subscription; retain existing Podman path.

Use a fixed version/architecture/URL/size/SHA pin, bounded staging download and existing job/progress/retry records. Distinguish download, verification, official installer/user action, engine starting and connected readiness. Unknown total or OS approval wait stays indeterminate.

Verify bytes and macOS signature/Gatekeeper acceptance before launching the official installer. Never redistribute vendor installer inside Manager without confirmed rights, never remove quarantine, collect admin password, accept license automatically, overwrite an existing Docker app or reset VM/data.

Open the verified vendor DMG/official installer and use official macOS installation path. Required OS authorization and vendor license decisions stay in system/vendor UI. The exact automated Applications installation API versus required official drag/drop step must be proven before claiming fully automatic install.

Start only the fixed detected official app/official desktop start command after explicit preparation; resume existing detect/info/compose probe until actual availability. App restart observes saved preparation state and actual installation rather than rerunning install. Do not auto-start engine on every Manager launch.
Keep current Studio chain and optional Capture/Processing independence. No extra account, provider, support environment, task or release gate.
